Dashboard header wraps, email is hidden, and pricing CTA stacks vertically. Chat mobile drawer, overlay, session history selection, New Chat close/reset, cookie reload persistence, and logout protection all pass. At 1920x800, Dashboard/build cards/conversations and Chat/sidebar/navigation render normally; Share and real AI chat send pass.

rca_of_the_issue: Resolved: Dashboard flex wrapping/mobile visibility and stacked banner classes remove the prior 223px overflow. Chat's breakpoint-controlled drawer/overlay and min-w-0 chat column remove the prior 124px overflow without regressing the desktop sidebar. Two intermediate browser-script failures were test assertion defects (checking the disabled send button after input clearing, then asserting Dashboard visibility before waiting for the protected route render); corrected assertions/retests passed and did not indicate product defects.
